types.doc: One dependency entry in a repo's `deps`.
types.name: tb.engine.dep

types.doc: One pinned dependency in a repo lock: a name, its remote, and the sha.
types.name: tb.engine.locked-package

types.doc:
The nominal meta marker. A type-def is legal in a `meta:` position only if
its resolved closure mixes this in, via `tb.engine.meta::tb-engine`. Abstract,
never claimed directly, a block names a concrete subtype that carries it.
types.name: tb.engine.meta

types.doc:
A repo's self-description at its root, `README.md`. Self-declared, its
sections say what the repo is, how to use it, and how to extend it.
types.name: tb.engine.readme

types.doc: One entry in the per-user registry: a name's remote and local path.
types.name: tb.engine.registry-entry

types.doc: A repo's committed identity and dependency set, `.2brain/repo.yaml`.
types.name: tb.engine.repo

types.doc: The per-user registry, `<state dir>/au-engine/config/repos.yaml` (see `repo::state_dir_in`), name to remote+path.
types.name: tb.engine.repos

types.doc: The optional workspace composition, `.2brain/workspace.yaml`, edit + discover members. `disabled:` overlays the role lists, a member declared but intentionally not mounted.
types.name: tb.engine.workspace

types.doc: One entry in the workspaces index: a workspace file and an optional alias.
types.name: tb.engine.workspace-entry
